description:
Ethereum mainnet on-chain read: the native balance of an address. Ethereum mainnet ETH balance of one address: eth_getBalance at the latest block, in wei. Takes address (0x + 40 hex). One plain JSON-RPC read, paid per call in USDC on Base.

GET https://api.arysphere.com/v1/ventures/x402_chain_reads_v1/eth_getbalance. Same payment terms as that HTTP route.
Call once with no payment. The result is the payment terms. Retry the same call with the signed payment at _meta["x402/payment"].
name: x402_chain_reads_v1__eth_getbalance
